description: This file implements functions for interpreting widget data related to overlays in a Vulkan graphics context, including managing widget types, limits, coordinate transformations, and rendering data for overlay widgets such as text and graphs.

classes.name: AppendWidgetDataHelper
classes.description: A helper class that interprets generic widget data into human-understandable overlay elements, generating text and scaling graph data.

methods.name: AppendFPS
methods.description: Appends FPS widget data to overlay buffers.

methods.name: AppendVulkanLastValidationMessage
methods.description: Appends the last Vulkan validation layer message to overlay buffers.

methods.name: AppendVulkanValidationMessageCount
methods.description: Appends the count of Vulkan validation messages.

methods.name: AppendVulkanSecondaryCommandBufferPoolWaste
methods.description: Appends secondary command buffer pool waste data.
